digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion for acceptance-criteria evidence classification
propositions: Plan review must independently classify every acceptance criterion as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested, requiring criterion-specific evidence and detecting both missing tags on external criteria and incorrect operator-attested tags on code-verifiable criteria.

Malformed or missing [operator-attested] tags on inherently external criteria must produce findings naming the exact syntax; criteria with exact case-insensitive tags must be accepted, while codebase-verifiable criteria incorrectly tagged operator-attested must produce findings explaining ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof.
Criteria mixing repository proof and external-world proof must not be silently assigned a single evidence kind; review must require the author to split them into independently certifiable criteria.
High-confidence misclassification findings must participate in normal validity × impact blocking policy, while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and fail-open.

Frozen-corpus evaluation across A1, historical cases, negatives, malformed tags, over-tagged code, and mixed-evidence items must achieve 100% precision on external-negative set, 100% recall on named fixtures, and ≥0.90 macro precision/recall across full corpus with no regression.
